chunks: And Jamīl ibn Darrāj narrated from him, peace be upon him:

Concerning a man who led a people on other than wudu (ablution), then withdrew and put forward another man, while the one put forward did not know what the Imam had prayed before him, he said: "Those behind him should remind him."

key_terms.أَمَّ: led as Imam in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the prayer leader in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْمُقَدَّمُ: the person put forward to replace the previous Imam
key_terms.مَنْ خَلْفَهُ: those praying behind him in the congregation
key_terms.وُضُوءٍ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification required for salat (prayer)
key_terms.يُذَكِّرُهُ: he is reminded or prompted regarding what to do next

ai.seo_question: What should happen if an Imam leaves congregational salat (prayer) and the replacement does not know how much has been prayed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for congregational salat (prayer) when the leading Imam must leave and appoint another person to continue. If the new leader does not know how much of the salat (prayer) has already been performed, those praying behind him should inform and remind him so the congregation can continue correctly.
